summary: MMA.INC, a NYSE American-listed Australian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 15, 2026 press release confirming deployment of its BJJLink software platform at UFC GYM's first standalone jiu-jitsu studio, opened August 8, 2026 at 383 Fifth Avenue, New York, with a Florida site expected January 2027. The disclosure is an ordinary commercial product-rollout update under an existing multi-year UFC GYM agreement, not a special situation. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch for incremental recurring software and payments revenue, not arbitrage.
